protocol.description: This protocol allows a river-window-management-v1 window manager to support wlr-layer-shell-unstable-v1.

interface.name: river_layer_shell_v1
interface.description: Binding this interface indicates that the window manager supports layer shell. The compositor should close layer surfaces if it is not bound.

interface.name: river_layer_shell_output_v1
interface.description: Its lifetime is tied to the corresponding river_output_v1.

interface.name: river_layer_shell_seat_v1
interface.description: Its lifetime is tied to the corresponding river_seat_v1.
